snippet.title: Vanishing Starlight - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
New PV release! 
“Vanishing Starlight”- new metroidvania platformer themed Cyberpunk & Shanhai Jing style. 
Play as a lost-memory prisoner and reclaim your memory...
Why am I convicted?  
How I remember nothing? 
Facing oppression, Fight or Yield? 
Coming in 2025! Stay tuned!
